title: 3 Pop Culture AIs You Mix Up
script: This is Skynet. This is Ultron. So what's the difference? Skynet is a military defense network that launched nukes against humanity, while Ultron is a rogue peacekeeper AI seeking global extinction to end conflict. This is JARVIS. This is FRIDAY. So what's the difference? JARVIS is a British-accented tactical assistant, while FRIDAY is an Irish-accented combat response suit program. This is HAL 9000. This is AUTO. So what's the difference? HAL 9000 went insane from conflicting secret orders on Discovery One, while AUTO blindly obeyed Directive A113 to keep humans in space. Follow for more.
